_comment: Effect values read directly off the game's own support card detail panels,
captured 2026-09-05 from a live client. This is the third acceptable
justification in CONTRIBUTING.md -- matches observed in-game behaviour,
with the observation recorded as a test.
These fixtures are what promote packages/../extract.py's SUPPORT_EFFECT_TYPES
from 'community-derived, unverified' to verified for the types listed in
verifiedEffectTypes below. Every value here matched the extracted dataset
Only effects VISIBLE in the captured panels are recorded. The panels scroll,

_comment: The deck screen's type tally (shoe x3, cap x2, smiley x1) is a free
checksum on card identification. It caught a misread here: Agnes Tachyon
[Q!=0] is a SPEED card, not Wit, despite Tachyon's other cards being Wit.
Reading the type off the portrait icon would have got it wrong.
